categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in industrial automation and intelligent manufacturing solutions, including control systems, instrumentation, industrial software, operation and maintenance services, and S2B business. It serves multiple industries such as chemical, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, energy, metallurgy, building materials, and emerging sectors like oil and gas and robotics. The company also provides integrated industrial AI-driven enterprise intelligent operation architectures and digital transformation services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include industrial AI with proprietary time-series pre-trained transformer models (TPT) and hypergraph transformer models (HGT) for process automation and business automation. The company develops universal control systems (UCS) with software-defined, fully digital, cloud-native architectures, advanced control systems (OMC), safety instrumented systems (SIS), compressor control systems (CCS), and intelligent instrumentation. Production methods emphasize digitalization, cloud-native platforms, AI integration, and modular design for automation equipment and instruments.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large-scale enterprises in process industries such as petrochemical, chemical, pharmaceutical, energy, metallurgy, building materials, and emerging sectors like oil and gas and liquor manufacturing. The company serves over 35,000 customers across more than 50 sub-industries, including major state-owned enterprises and multinational corporations. It also targets international markets with projects in Southeast Asia, Middle East, Europe, Americas, and Japan.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China, covering major industrial regions including East China, North China, Central China, Northwest, Southwest, South China, and Northeast. It has a growing international presence with subsidiaries and operations in Singapore, Saudi Arabia, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Kazakhstan, Canada, Japan, and other countries. Overseas business accounts for over 8% of revenue, with rapid growth in international contracts.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial automation supply chain, providing core control systems, industrial software, instrumentation, and integrated solutions. It also engages in upstream R&D and manufacturing of automation hardware and software products, and downstream services including installation, commissioning, and lifecycle operation and maintenance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities focus on advancing industrial AI technologies, including large-scale industrial AI models (TPT and HGT), AI-driven autonomous operation systems, and AI-robotics integration. The company emphasizes R&D in software-defined control systems, cloud-native platforms, intelligent instrumentation, and digital twin technologies. It pursues innovation in AI-assisted catalyst development, predictive maintenance, energy efficiency, and safety management, supported by a strong R&D team and extensive patent portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of industrial automation equipment, instrumentation, and industrial software licenses. The company also derives income from integrated solutions, engineering projects, operation and maintenance services, and a growing subscription-based membership model for industrial software. Additionally, it earns revenue from S2B platform transactions and value-added services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in China’s industrial automation sector, with a domestic market share of 40.4% in distributed control systems (DCS), and leading shares in safety instrumented systems (SIS) and other core products. It competes with traditional industrial automation firms and emerging AI and software companies. Its strong R&D, extensive customer base, and integrated AI solutions differentiate it as a top-tier player in the industrial AI and automation market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 9.14 billion, a 6.02% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.12 billion, up 1.38%. R&D investment accounted for 10.7% of revenue. The company has shown steady growth in domestic and international markets, with overseas revenue doubling and expanding global footprint. It maintains strong cash flow generation and a solid asset base exceeding RMB 18 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique industrial AI capabilities, integrating vast industrial data with AI models to enable autonomous, intelligent operation of process industries. Its universal control system disrupts traditional architectures with software-defined, cloud-native designs that reduce costs and improve efficiency. The company offers comprehensive lifecycle solutions combining automation hardware, software, AI, and robotics, delivering enhanced safety, quality, energy efficiency, and operational benefits to customers. Its extensive ecosystem and global service network further enhance customer value.
